name: Incident rescue
description: Rescue an active incident with facts first, the smallest reversible recovery action, and an honest record of residual risk.

outcomes.description: Observed events, impact, and current safety boundaries are ordered without invented causes.
A bounded recovery or safe abandonment decision is verified and recorded for follow-up.

prerequisites.description: The incident has observable signals, affected surface, and a current impact statement.
prerequisites.check: Separate observed facts from hypotheses before proposing a change.

prerequisites.description: The smallest reversible recovery action and its stop conditions are understood.
prerequisites.check: Identify the restore route and owner boundaries before acting.

lanes.objective: Build a factual timeline, impact summary, hypotheses, and explicit stop conditions.
Apply or prepare the smallest reversible recovery action inside the declared scope.
Verify recovery signals, user impact, and follow-up evidence without rewriting the timeline.

qualityGates.description: The timeline distinguishes observations, hypotheses, actions, and unknowns.
The recovery action has a known restore route and does not broaden the incident scope.
Post-action health or impact checks support the stated recovery outcome or abandonment.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response during incident rescue.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; preserve a redacted context package for the human step.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Perform destructive data work, billing or account-security changes, or live financial execution while recovering.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Incident urgency does not remove protected owner boundaries.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Prefer the last known-good release or documented reversible action, and preserve the factual timeline if recovery fails.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted observations before and after the action.
Stop on contradictory health or impact signals.
Record unresolved risk and hand off rather than guessing.
stopConditions: The proposed recovery is irreversible or unreviewed.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and sensitive user content.
Record event classes and safe release identifiers only.
